android.desc:
Command Hell. Rule Every Battle.

Unleash the Warlock, the newest class in Diablo Immortal, Blizzard’s free to play action MMORPG set in the Diablo universe.

Harness forbidden magic, form dark pacts, and fight alongside The Soulgorger — a permanent demon companion that joins every battle. No summons. No cooldowns. Just relentless pressure as you dominate enemies solo or with your clan.

Master positioning, control the battlefield, and dictate the flow of combat. This isn’t just a new class — it’s a new way to conquer Sanctuary.

A DARK FANTASY ACTION MMORPG
The world of Sanctuary is torn apart by the Eternal Conflict between angels and demons. As humanity’s last hope, you’ll explore a shared open world filled with danger, demons, and legendary rewards.
Diablo Immortal delivers nonstop action RPG combat, deep progression, and an epic dark fantasy story — all optimized for mobile and PC.
COMBAT WITHOUT LIMTS — ANYTIME, ANYWHERE
•	Real time ARPG combat with responsive controls
•	Solo play, co op dungeons, raids, and PvP arenas
•	Seamless cross platform play across mobile and PC

A LIVING, EVER EVOLVING WORLD
Sanctuary never stands still.
•	Frequent updates with new story chapters and features
•	Massive world bosses, events, and seasonal challenges
•	Iconic locations inspired by Diablo lore

PLAY TOGETHER IN A TRUE MMORPG
•	Form Warbands for small group co op
•	Join Clans to earn rewards and dominate leaderboards
•	Raid dungeons, trade loot, and battle other players
Your choices shape your legend.

FORGED BY BLIZZARD
With AAA production, constant updates, and endless ways to play, Diablo Immortal is the ultimate mobile MMORPG for Diablo fans.
The war for Sanctuary has begun. Download now and become a legend.

IN-GAME PURCHASES (INCLUDES RANDOM ITEMS)
